title: The Unrevisable
summary: Aurel Pendry wants to see how you look at things that can be revised before he lets you near the one thing that cannot. Bring him two broken workings from the world, a ward at a town gate and a wound where a piece came down, and look at each until you can say what it is failing to do. The third broken working is the one he has studied for twenty years.

objectives.text: Bring him the first broken working
